items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Are there any contemporary composers whose work inspires you to write lyrics? For instance, Matt and I were just thinking...

ctx.x: I think so, whether consciously so or not. I think all the good music that you hear is utilized by you, if only to try to emulate in what you do its beauty and its harmony and its melody.

Are there any contemporary composers whose work inspires you to write lyrics? For instance, Matt and I were just thinking, when you said that you always have music going on in your head. I just wonder, for instance, during these past few days or even last weeks or so – just in this time frame – what kinds of things are you working on in your mind?
